description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling 'ModifyFeatureProperty' commands in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides functionality to modify or create feature properties within a Thing entity, including size validation, event generation, and header management.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles 'ModifyFeatureProperty' commands, capable of modifying existing feature properties or creating new ones, and generating appropriate events and headers.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command to modify or create a feature property within a Thing, validating size constraints, and returning the resulting event or error.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the feature from the Thing based on the command's feature ID.

methods.name: getModifyOrCreateResult
methods.description: Determines whether to modify an existing feature property or create a new one, returning the corresponding result.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Generates a mutation result for modifying an existing feature property, including event creation and header management.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Generates a mutation result for creating a new feature property, including event creation and header management.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag associated with the previous state of the feature property, if present.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Creates an entity tag for the new value of the feature property.
